text: - drochloride). ATC — N06AX19. ATC Vet — QN06AX19. (gepirone) Profile Gepirone is structurally related to buspirone (p.965). It has been investigated as the hydrochloride for the treatment of depression and anxiety disorders. Action. Gepirone is a partial agonist at serotonin (hydroxytryp- tamine, 5-HT) receptors of the 5-HT1A subtype. For reference to the actions and potential uses of such drugs, see Buspirone, p.966.
